description:
Residual from review finding R6, verified still present post-batch:
TuningMetadataManager._as_benchmark_tunings (benchbox/core/tuning/metadata.py)
persists only pk/fk flags + table tunings, dropping unique/check constraints
and ALL platform optimizations. Reused-database drift detection is therefore
blind to z-order/liquid/session-relevant drift. Widen the persisted record
(schema-compatible: add typed rows or a config-hash-per-section) and the
validate_unified_tunings comparison to cover the full UnifiedTuningConfiguration,
feeding the richer result into the drift_check companion field added by the
applied-ledger work.

preserves.behavior: Existing benchbox_tuning_metadata tables written by older versions must still load (versioned or additive schema)
save failure remains non-fatal to the run

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/tuning -q -k 'metadata or drift'
verifications.description: Drift tests green incl. platform-optimization drift

work_units.summary: Extend the metadata persistence to cover unique/check constraints and platform optimizations
Extend validate_unified_tunings comparison + drift_check payload; migration handling for old metadata tables
Tests: drift in a platform optimization (e.g. z_ordering toggled) is detected on reuse; old-format tables load without error
